styleSelection.reason: The sail, hull and rigging are carried by fitted watercolor value shapes with mixed edges; all drawing files are empty, so structure stays in paint.

families.referenceCue: The dominant bowed pale blue-white sail; keep its light interior broad, with cool broken turning planes and a curved outer edge.
The dark blue-grey hull and reflected base, one connected mass with a few irregular pale breaks rather than a black outline.
Turquoise water below the right-hand horizon, broad and soft, with thin broken light streaks left open.
Quiet warm-white air and the pale secondary sail; preserve the open paper and soften only the distant transitions.
Warm ochre and sienna rigging crossing the left sail; narrow, intermittent painted strokes, never a ruled contour.
The slender warm mast at the right edge, broken with cool notes and allowed to lose itself near the water.
